name: Direct Debit Mandate
definition: Authorisation in favour of the creditor given by the debtor to debit its own account.

FinalCollectionDate.name: Final Collection Date
FinalCollectionDate.definition: Date of the final collection of a direct debit as per the mandate.

FirstCollectionDate.name: First Collection Date
FirstCollectionDate.definition: Date of the first collection of a direct debit as per the mandate.

CollectionAmount.name: Collection Amount
CollectionAmount.definition: Fixed amount that the debtor has agreed will be collected from their account.

MaximumAmount.name: Maximum Amount
MaximumAmount.definition: Maximum amount that may be collected from the debtor's account, per instruction.

PreNotification.name: Pre Notification
PreNotification.definition: Indicates wether a pre-notification must be sent by the creditor to the debtor before a direct debit occurs

PreNotificationThreshold.name: Pre Notification Threshold
PreNotificationThreshold.definition: Specifies the number of days before the direct debit for notifying the debtor.

PointInTime.name: Point In Time
PointInTime.definition: Specifies a frequency in terms of an exact point in time or moment within a specified period type.

RelatedDirectDebit.name: Related Direct Debit
RelatedDirectDebit.definition: Direct debit to which a mandate applies.
